paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai the earlier, and his sons, tannaim Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Dostai—see their entries—in Rabbi Akiva’s and Rabbi Meir’s time. This requires examination, for Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Yannai lived in Rabbi Yochanan’s days. Perhaps it is as Tosafot, Ketubbot, says: there is a Rabbi Yochanan who was a tanna; see his entry. גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] writes: at Akhbara, in a cave in a vineyard, Rabbi Yannai, Rabbi Dostai, and Rabbi Nehorai are buried. But I do not know which Rabbi Yannai. Still, Rabbi Dostai too is buried there, and was this Rabbi Yannai’s son.
